plain-blocks.evidence: The 3D extruded typography with moving studio-light reflections creates a strong visual event (Spectacle 88). The sung word is consistently highlighted in gold against white/silver text, providing clear hierarchy and legibility across both dark and light backgrounds (Readability 92). The word-by-word reveal and camera tracking are coherent, though the transitions between phrases (e.g., frame 6 to 7) feel slightly abrupt rather than fluid (Choreography 85). The type selection is bold and professional, with good spacing and color relationships (Craft 87). The concept of sculpted lyrics is effective but not highly unique in the motion graphics space (Originality 78). No critical defects or clipping on held text were observed.
improvements: Smooth out the transition between the end of one phrase and the start of the next to improve flow.
Consider adding a subtle camera push or pull during the hold frames to increase dynamism.
Refine the lighting reflection to be slightly more pronounced for a higher-end finish.
